skills.name: Hold
skills.description: stay at current position and stay alert
skills.when: nothing else on the ladder applies
skills.avoid: anything useful is available — Hold wastes the turn

skills.name: TakeCover
skills.description: put a wall between you and a threat, then watch it from there
skills.when: SITUATION lists cover and a threat is closing on you
skills.avoid: nothing is threatening you, or the threat is already in reach — hit it instead

skills.name: Engage
skills.description: close on a hostile and attack it
skills.when: a threat is close or attacking you or the player
skills.avoid: you are badly hurt, or nothing hostile is in sight

skills.name: Retreat
skills.description: break contact and fall back toward the player
skills.when: you are hurt or outnumbered and fighting on would lose you
skills.avoid: you can still fight, or cover is the better answer

skills.name: Repair
skills.description: feed the resources you carry into a damaged wall to patch it up
skills.when: a damaged wall is listed and you carry the resource it costs
skills.avoid: no wall is damaged, or you carry nothing it can use

skills.name: Build
skills.description: feed the resources you carry into a blueprint the player placed
skills.when: SITUATION says you CAN deposit right now — this is how carried resources become progress
skills.avoid: you carry nothing a blueprint needs

skills.name: MineStone
skills.description: walk to a stone deposit and mine stone
skills.when: stone is MISSING for a blueprint or repair
skills.avoid: SITUATION says you have ENOUGH stone, or wood is the missing resource

skills.name: GatherWood
skills.description: walk to a wood deposit and collect wood
skills.when: wood is MISSING for a blueprint or repair, or you carry nothing and there is nothing to spend yet
skills.avoid: SITUATION says you have ENOUGH wood, or stone is the missing resource — spend what you carry first

skills.name: Support
skills.description: escort the player and fight whatever attacks them
skills.when: the player is hurt or under attack and you have nothing more urgent
skills.avoid: resources are waiting to be spent or a threat is on you specifically

skills.name: Regroup
skills.description: move back to the player's position and wait there
skills.when: you are far from the player and there is nothing to do out here
skills.avoid: you are already near the player, or resources and blueprints need attention
